title: PnP Community Pets: Emote Library Manifest
description: Drop this file in your emote folder under media/emotes/<your-emote>/emote.json

id.description: Unique ID for this emote. Defaults to the folder name if omitted.

name.description: Display name shown in the emote picker.

description.description: One-line description shown in the emote picker.

imageFile.description: Filename of the emote image (PNG, SVG, or GIF; transparent background recommended), relative to this folder.
